title: Spark's Groove
logline: A shy, vintage robot hiding in the shadows of a lively rooftop party finds the courage to step onto the dance floor with the help of a charismatic dancer.
theme: Overcoming social anxiety and finding joy in self-expression.

characters.name: Spark
characters.one_line_description: A charmingly clunky, brass-plated robot who is self-conscious about its stiff movements.

characters.name: Nova
characters.one_line_description: An energetic, expressive human dancer with a welcoming smile and neon-streaked hair.

scenes.title: Hiding in the Shadows
scenes.summary: Spark stands nervously behind a large potted palm on a glittering rooftop terrace, watching stylish partygoers dance to a vibrant beat.

scenes.title: An Invitation
scenes.summary: Nova notices Spark shivering with hesitation, dances over with a smooth slide, and extends an inviting hand with a warm grin.

scenes.title: First Rusty Steps
scenes.summary: Spark hesitatingly mimics Nova's simple side-step, its gears whirring loudly as it attempts to find the rhythm.

scenes.title: Finding the Rhythm
scenes.summary: Nova cheers Spark on. Spark's chest lights flash in sync with the music as it executes a surprisingly fluid spin and a perfect robotic pop.

scenes.title: The Center of Attention
scenes.summary: Other partygoers crowd around, clapping to Spark's beat as Spark and Nova strike a final, confident synchronized pose together.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
